input: Sign my kid up for a coding bootcamp

gold.taskTitle: Sign My Kid Up for a Coding Bootcamp
gold.taskDescription: Find and enroll a child in a suitable coding bootcamp program.

questions.title: How old is your child right now?
questions.description: The child's age determines which bootcamps and skill levels are appropriate.

questions.title: Does your child have any prior coding experience?
questions.description: Knowing their current skill level helps identify beginner, intermediate, or advanced programs.

questions.title: Do you want an in-person, online, or hybrid bootcamp?
questions.description: The format preference narrows down the available options significantly.

questions.title: What is your budget for this bootcamp?
questions.description: Bootcamp costs range from free to several hundred dollars, so a budget helps filter choices.

questions.title: When do you need the bootcamp to start?
questions.description: The target start date or season determines which upcoming sessions are relevant.

questions.title: Is there a specific coding language or topic you want covered?
questions.description: Some families have a preference such as Scratch, Python, web development, or game design.

questions.title: How many hours per week can your child commit?
questions.description: Time availability determines whether a intensive, part-time, or weekend-only program fits best.
